name: Undekhi
description: Show depicts the two aspects of the society - the power-drunk influential people who think they can get away with anything and the oppressed, subjected to years of torture, who finally decide to bring themselves to justice

videos.title: The Things That Men Do
videos.overview: Rishi and Saloni, two filmmakers travel to Manali to shoot a friend’s wedding. Rishi accidentally records the murder of a ‘dancing girl’ by the groom’s father and struggles with his conscience. As he tries to find out what happened, DSP Ghosh, a cop from West Bengal arrives in Manali, who is looking out for the same ‘dancing girl’ in a murder case.

videos.title: Is This For Real?
videos.overview: Rishi makes a horrific discovery in the doghouse next to the resort. Saloni tries to get him to focus on the work but Rinku and his cousins are onto Rishi. He must come up with a Plan B. DSP Ghosh, senses a cover-up, heads to the resort.

videos.title: For Cash Only
videos.overview: Ghosh interrogates Saloni and team to Rinku’s chagrin and finds discrepancies in their stories. Meanwhile, the wedding festivities continue. Teji confronts Daman about the shooting. Saloni cracks a deal with Rinku in exchange for Rishi’s silence.

videos.title: Double Shuffle
videos.overview: Ghosh arrives with a search warrant on the wedding day. Lucky manages to get Rishi, Koyal, and Praful out of the doghouse just in time. But, someone is on their trail. An angry Teji lashes out at Daman and the wedding comes to an abrupt halt.

videos.title: Catch The Tiger By The Tail
videos.overview: Rishi, Koyal, and Praful give Ghosh and the others a tough chase as they track them in the jungle. Saloni tells Teji about the murder and their predicament. Rinku lays a trap for Rishi and pins murder on him.

videos.title: The Can Of Worms
videos.overview: Rishi manages to contact Saloni at the resort. Pressure mounts on DSP Ghosh and he has a chance encounter with Teji. Daman tells Teji the truth and she has a tough decision to make. Meanwhile, Lucky is in for a surprise.

videos.title: You Have It Coming
videos.overview: Rinku is onto the fugitive’s whereabouts as the wedding ceremony starts again. Shashwat tries to contact Rishi. Teji surprises everyone with a change in stance. DSP Ghosh has a showdown with Rinku and Papaji.

videos.title: We Have Got Ourselves A Deal
videos.overview: Rinku gets the better of DSP Ghosh. Shashwat and Alice arrive in Manali and are sucked into the desperate situation immediately. Rinku receives a package and realises that the power is shifting away from him. He makes a cunning move.

videos.title: You Are Safe When Dead
videos.overview: Lucky manages to find Rishi and gang but they escape again. Timma finds the murder video on Rishi’s phone. The video now becomes Rishi’s last line of defense. Rinku decides to sort this out himself.

videos.title: An Ace In My Hand
videos.overview: As the dust settles after the killing, Rinku and Papaji plan to get rid of Teji. DSP Ghosh is visited by Koyal and he now has all the pieces of the Sundarban puzzle. Rinku and Ghosh try to outwit each other with the cops being on Rinku’s side and an unlikely ally on Ghosh’s.

videos.title: The Wild Goose Chase
videos.overview: Rinku continues his search for Koyal as Ghosh and Teji conspire to take her to safety. While Saloni and the team are on their way out of Manali, Rinku has other plans for them.

videos.title: Needle In A Haystack
videos.overview: Ghosh gives Teji a hint which might help her bring down the Atwals. Lucky finds himself in a pickle when his targets make a run for their lives and escape.

videos.title: Might Of The Atwal Empire
videos.overview: A new player comes in as a roadblock to Atwal’s plans of business expansion. Daman and Teji are determined to save their friends and make inroads into the family business.

videos.title: True Lies
videos.overview: As the Atwal's prepare to welcome their new bride, Rinku doesn’t have a moment to breathe. In the meantime, new secrets about the business are revealed to Samarth.

videos.title: Wedding Bells Make A Loud Sound
videos.overview: Rinku finds out who the real culprit is behind the missing truck while getting married to Muskaan. Daman-Teji gets in touch with their old friends, this may give them an advantage over Rinku!

videos.title: Revenge Is Best Served Cold
videos.overview: An intruder breaks into the Atwal resort and attacks one of the Atwals. Abhaya finds out he has more in common with Koyal than he thought. Daman-Teji makes headway into their plan of becoming business partners with Samarth, while some friends turn into foes.

videos.title: The Girl And The Cop
videos.overview: Rinku presses on with his plans of expanding into a new business territory, while those against him have different agendas. Ghosh makes progress in his investigation to find Koyal and take her to safety.

videos.title: Goons, Guns And Bombs
videos.overview: The sound of the explosive is heard across the valley and the tremors are felt within the Atwal empire itself. Rinku decides to take charge of the operation but there’s another surprise in store for him.

videos.title: The Hunter Is Now The Hunted
videos.overview: Rinku sets a plan in motion with Arjan Singh and executes immaculately. Samarth pulls in all his resources and announces a face-off with the mighty Atwals.

videos.title: That’s The Way The Cookie Crumbles
videos.overview: Old players reappear as do some new ones in this game of Russian roulette, where the stakes are higher than life itself. Each one has a motive to take down the other – driven by their thirst for power, revenge and love.

videos.title: Skeletons In The Closet
videos.overview: Papaji is recovering from his injuries and has given up alcohol while Rinku is trying to revive the business. However, Teji has plans of her own which lead to tension and a power struggle in the family. Meanwhile, Ghosh is ridden with guilt after Koyal’s death and has become a recluse, as amysterious new entity emerges with a vendetta and a sinister plan to bring down the Atwals.

videos.title: Catch Me If You Can
videos.overview: Ghosh arrives in Manali and assumes leadership of a team which has been put together to arrest Papaji for Kanak’s murder. Daman hires a lawyer to defend Papaji while Rinku scrambles to put together a plan to thwart Ghosh and a game of cat and mouse ensues. Meanwhile, Teji makes a shocking discovery about someone from her past.

videos.title: Bite The Bullet
videos.overview: Ghosh manages to outwit the Atwals and finally arrests Papaji while Rinku confronts the new player in town, Rajveer Malhotra, who offers him a partnership. Samarth is on the run and asks for Ghosh’s help in exchange for information. However, Rinku is hot on his trail.

videos.title: Game, Set, But Match?
videos.overview: As Papaji’s trial date gets closer, Ghosh scrambles to gather new evidence while Rinku goes on a rampage, determined to destroy his enemies. However, Ghosh discovers a chink in Rinku’s armour and makes a startling discovery that threatens to blow the case wide open.

videos.title: Trial By Fire
videos.overview: The trial is underway and the Atwals are under fire from Ghosh and the prosecution. Papaji’s freedom is at stake, and just when everything seems hopeless, Rinku pulls a rabbit out of the hat and all hell breaks loose.

videos.title: It's Not Over Till It's Over
videos.overview: Ghosh suffers a huge loss and is broken after another setback in his war against the Atwals. But he sees a ray of hope when he discovers a hidden link between the Atwals and Rajveer Malhotra. Meanwhile, Rinku celebrates with the family, unaware that a storm is coming.

videos.title: The Darkest Hour
videos.overview: Teji’s lying and scheming catches up to her as she desperately tries to keep her world from unravelling. Meanwhile, Rinku and Daman discover the betrayal of a trusted ally and are hell bent on revenge, while Papaji is plagued by the ghosts of his past.

videos.title: Karma Is A Bitch
videos.overview: Rinku’s world is shattered and he goes on a rampage, determined to make his enemy pay. But, in the process, he makes a shocking discovery that turns his life upside down.

videos.title: The Cage Opens
videos.overview: Five years after Season 3, Rinku rebuilds his Chandigarh empire with his biological father Mahinder Atwal, expanding globally through a high-stakes deal with the Dhillon brothers, led by hip-hop star Bobby Dhillon. As Papaji awaits a crucial court verdict from prison, Ghosh joins Rashi in probing a chilling string of missing girls. When Papaji is acquitted and walks free, Rinku vows to destroy him. A war between father figures becomes inevitable.

videos.title: Truth Will Out
videos.overview: As Rinku prepares for Bobby Dhillon's high-profile music launch, Papaji secretly moves against Mahi. Ghosh's probe into missing girls leads him to the same event, bringing him face-to-face with Rinku. Papaji abducts Deepika to locate Kavita, a witness to Muskaan's death. When Mahi learns Kavita is alive, he kills Deepika and leaks Kavita's location to Papaji. Daman reaches Kavita first and learns a fourth person was present the night Muskaan died-before DJ kills Kavita and shoots Daman, leaving his life hanging by a thread.

videos.title: Double Jeopardy
videos.overview: Rinku and Papaji's war escalates when Papaji, secretly backed by Narcotics, orchestrates Bobby Dhillon's assassination, shattering Mahi's drug empire. Jogi turns on Rinku, forcing him to ally with Sukhi to save the deal. Daman tells Rinku that a fourth person was present the night Muskaan died, suggesting Papaji may have been framed. As Saloni investigates, Papaji strikes again, tipping off Narcotics and seizing Rinku's entire consignment, reclaiming the upper hand.

videos.title: Blood Ain't Thicker Than Water
videos.overview: Ghosh traces the missing students to Vikram Saluja's Dreamroots Foundation, raising suspicions of Rinku's possible links to trafficking. Rinku learns Sukhi betrayed him by siding with Papaji and Narcotics; in response, Jogi kills his own brother but remains loyal. Seeking safer distribution, Rinku and Mahi turn to Vikram's logistics empire, only to face a rival offer from Papaji and Daman. As Vikram plays both sides, Rinku exposes Papaji's covert deal with Narcotics, triggering a public scandal and shifting the power balance once again.

videos.title: The Father, The Son & The Unholy Katana
videos.overview: With Papaji under scrutiny, Vikram backs Rinku and revives his deal with Jogi Dhillon. A desperate Papaji turns to Kanwal's brother Harmeet, who reveals buried truths and hands over Kanwal's letters. Ghosh uncovers the "Royal Circle," a powerful syndicate tied to the missing girls, and begins suspecting Vikram and Rinku, while questioning Teji's death. As Daman aids Ghosh, shocks emerge - Papaji learns DJ is Mahi's illegitimate son, and Saloni discovers DJ was Muskaan's killer.

videos.title: The Kiss Of Judas
videos.overview: Papaji confronts DJ about being Mahi's illegitimate son and offers him the Atwal legacy. Daman uncovers a clue on Natasha's phone pointing to a secret Royal Circle meeting, while Rinku grows suspicious of Vikram. Saloni blackmails Mahi with the truth about DJ killing Muskaan. DJ seemingly betrays Mahi by leaking a drug consignment to Papaji, triggering a narcotics raid - but it's a trap. Gunfire erupts, Lucky dies saving Papaji, and as DJ escapes, Papaji reveals the truth to Rinku: DJ is Mahi's son.

videos.title: The Reckoning Begins
videos.overview: Mahi claims DJ as his son but orders him to stay hidden as Rinku goes to war after Lucky's death. Mahi lies to Rinku, saying DJ has gone rogue. Ghosh and Daman uncover Teji's murder and force Natasha to reveal the Royal Circle's secret auction at Vikram's hotel. During an undercover raid, Daman and Natasha kill Vikram but Daman is badly wounded. As DJ ambushes Saloni, Rinku intervenes and finally realizes the truth-Mahi orchestrated Muskaan's murder.

videos.title: The Grave He Dug
videos.overview: Rinku kills DJ, avenging Muskaan and uncovering the truth-Mahi murdered Kanwal, orchestrated Muskaan's death, and helped build the Royal Circle. Rinku and Papaji finally reunite as father and son. During a Royal Circle bust, Natasha gives Ghosh a hard drive exposing powerful clients. Mahi retaliates by kidnapping Samaira, forcing a final showdown. Rinku, Papaji, and Ghosh defeat Mahi and rescue Samaira-but an unknown man arrives, demanding the drive and warning that this war is far from over.
